# Arwright

> Arwright is a writing-process platform for middle and high schools that helps students use AI responsibly without losing their own thinking. Instead of writing or rewriting student work, it coaches students and shows teachers how a piece of writing was actually built: drafts, revisions, pastes, and AI use.

## Who it's for
- Middle and high school teachers in any subject that assigns writing
- School and district leaders setting AI and academic-integrity policy
- Students who want to grow as writers and keep a portfolio of their work

## What it does
- In-house word processor that captures the writing process
- AI writing coach that guides students with questions and feedback, not ghostwriting
- Process replay so teachers can watch how a draft developed
- Integrity review that flags pasted text and sudden typing bursts
- Classes and assignments for teachers
- Students can export their work anytime and keep it after graduation

## Approach
Arwright focuses on teaching responsible AI use rather than catching students. AI detectors tend to create mistrust; Arwright gives teachers a picture of real student growth.

## Status
Early stage. Arwright is preparing for its first free school pilots. A student AI-use research study is being prepared for IRB submission.
